reference.isolates: metrics, boundary conditions and flux; no lift, no shock
sources: J. C. Vassberg and A. Jameson, 'In Pursuit of Grid Convergence for Two-Dimensional Euler Solutions', J. Aircraft 47 (2010) 1152-1166; preprint http://aero-comlab.stanford.edu/Papers/AIAA-46737-375.pdf
reference.notes: The three codes report CD 4.5e-8, 5.0e-8 and -1.9e-7, zero within their noise. cd_tol 1e-5 is two orders above that and two below the wave drag of m08a0. Zero references make cl_tol and cd_tol absolute.
